    obj = observe()["objects"]["green_pen"]

             if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True)
             and c.get("hand_clear", True)
             and c.get("fingers_clear", True)]
    if clear:
        c = min(clear, key=lambda c: (c["x"] - obj["center"][0]) ** 2 +
                                      (c["y"] - obj["center"][1]) ** 2)
        c["height"] = min(c.get("height", 0.009), 0.009)
        grasp(c)

if observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    carry_over_zone("purple_box", 0.15)
    z = observe()["zones"]["purple_box"]
    target = z["long_axis_yaw"] + math.atan2(z["half_size"][1], z["half_size"][0])
    gp = gripper_pose()
    cur = math.atan2(gp["side"][1], gp["side"][0])
    d = target - cur
    while d > math.pi / 2:
        d -= math.pi
    while d < -math.pi / 2:
        d += math.pi
    rotate_by(d)
    drop_into_container_v2("green_pen", "purple_box", 0.12)
    check("green_pen", "purple_box")
